name: airbnb-data-scraper
what_it_holds: A pay-per-use commercial scraper explicitly marketed as 'a pay-per-use AirDNA alternative' -- scrapes airbnb.com listings, prices, availability, occupancy, ADR/RevPAR and reviews to JSON/CSV. Updated Sep 2026.
why_useful: Directly targets airbnb.com itself, not a third-party vendor, so it falls under the repo's rule 6 (any scraping of airbnb.com beyond the sanctioned Inside Airbnb / fee-panel captures is a ToS decision for a human) -- flagged only for completeness/awareness, not recommended to run.

name: Web_Scrape (AirDNA Surrey BC)
what_it_holds: Two committed CSVs (AirDNA_Surrey.csv, AirDNA_Surrey_2.csv) pulled via requests+BeautifulSoup against AirDNA's API for one city, Surrey, BC, Canada. Fields and date range not confirmed by fetch (page render limited); 10 commits total, author describes analysis as 'very basic'.
why_useful: Directly addresses gap #2 (realised ADR/occupancy for STRs from a free/scraped AirDNA source) even though scope is a single small Canadian city — worth a manual pull to see actual columns (likely occupancy/ADR/revenue estimates AirDNA shows on its public city pages).

name: air_dna_scraper
what_it_holds: Selenium scraper configured to pull AirDNA's general city-level STR metrics (occupancy, ADR proxies) currently set up for Washington State cities. No committed output data visible; scrapes a paid/login-gated AirDNA market-data page.
why_useful: A working method to reproduce AirDNA's public city-summary numbers (occupancy/ADR/RevPAR) for WA cities without a paid account, addressing gap #2. Would need to be run to get data; per repo rules only catalogued, not run.
